posts.author: AmeerAshourDraws
posts.body:
Now, I've been contemplating whether or not I've been wanting to do this post because I'm not exactly gonna be very active here, I'm just peeping my head in every once in a while, or at any time I feel like it, but I figured I'd make this post just to give you guys a general idea who I am.
I'm AmeerAshourDraws, and I'm a digital artist who loves video games and also does some suggestive content. I'm a huge fan of Super Mario, Sonic the Hedgehog, Mega Man X, and Chrono Trigger, and I pretty much draw whatever comes to mind. I'm obviously not gonna share any of my works here, if you want to see them, you can view my
DeviantArt
or
Twitter
pages, though another warning, I do suggestive content which I know it's not up to everyone's tastes.
Now, right off the bat, I'm not looking to be hired as an artist for any game or any project here, nor do I want to be picked up for any game projects, I'm just learning how RPG Maker works because I want to make a fangame with Chrono Trigger's systems mixed with some Mario & Luigi elements, my two favorite RPG series', and I'm pretty much a hobbyist when it comes to RPG Maker. I'm still learning how everything works and learning how to properly script in RPG Maker, I do know a small amount of JavaScript, though I'm still relatively a noob, and I'm currently learning how to fully utilize Pixi in RPG Maker.
Have I don anything with RPG Maker? I have some stuff. I am currently messing around with MZ and trying to unfold its secrets, and I did manage to get
Moghunter's Chrono Engine running in MZ in Chrono Mode
, and also found a way
to run MZ games on Android using an app called MadiVes
, both of which will be linked for those who want to know how to do it. And I have messed around in the engine to some extent, making weird stuff like this.
I also made a random short suggestive hypnosis game, or pretty much a movie, in XP (I snagged it when it was free on Steam for a while) as a way to understand how to make cutscenes in RPG Maker, it's called Every RPG Maker Game is Personalized, you can check it out on my Itch.io page if you're curious. (A sequel may be planned)
(Hypnosis Parody) Every RPG Maker Game is Personalized by AmeerAshourDraws
A Short Hypnosis Parody Movie of a Creepypasta
ameerashourdraws.itch.io
And that's pretty much it. Once again, I'm not willing to be very active here, and the reason is because I'm already a busy college student and also because I do a lot of owed Ko-Fi art and stuff, so I'm pretty much always working. Messing around in RPG Maker MZ is a side thing at the moment. If I can do something in it, I'll do something in it. I don't know how active I'll be here, since I'm not that big of a frequent user here, so don't expect me to be that active.
And yeah, that's pretty much all I have to say right now heh
